title: Projection-symmetry action on hidden port-response representation
question: On the selected Resolution-R boundary realization, does the admissible projection-symmetry action carry the hidden port-response operator by similarity/conjugacy so that the trace/spectral class is preserved?
trigger_to_reopen: Recover or type one representation rho_Pi:G_Pi->GL(Vbar_H) with Lambda(g.x)=rho_Pi(g)Lambda(x)rho_Pi(g)^(-1), or a weaker trace-preservation contract sufficient for the selected comparator.
